product.name: HP LP03XL Battery
product.full_name: Replacement Battery for HP ENVY 14-J / 15-AE / M6-P Series
product.description: Replacement battery (Model LP03XL, Regulatory Model HSTNN-DB7C) for HP ENVY 14-J series, ENVY 15-AE series, ENVY 15T-AE series, and selected ENVY M6-P series including M6-P113DX and M6-P013DX. Also cross-compatible with 804072-241, 804072-541, 805094-005, 807211-121, 807211-221, 807211-241 and 807417-005. 3-cell, 60Wh, 11.4V Li-ion, approx. 5,260mAh. Tested before dispatch, drop-in fit — no disassembly beyond the standard battery bay.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on this battery?
faqs.answer: Yes — this battery carries a 6-month warranty from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: How do I install it?
faqs.answer: It's a standard drop-in replacement — no disassembly beyond the battery bay. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if needed.

faqs.question: Can I pay via M-Pesa?
faqs.answer: Yes, M-Pesa is accepted, along with cash on delivery in select areas.
